high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an academic paper titled "Real-Time Reasoning Agents in Evolving Environments." The paper is authored by Yule Wen, Yixin Ye, Yanzhe Zhang, Diyi Yang, and Hao Zhu, with affiliations listed as Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Georgia Institute of Technology, and Stanford University. The authors note that the work was done during an internship at Stanford University.
